steps.message:
The edit itself is one line: `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30` → `480` in `config.js:3` (`server.js:3` is the only consumer, so nothing else needs touching).

Before I make it: this is a security-posture change, not just a value. A 16x longer session window means a stolen session token or an unattended logged-in browser stays valid for a full workday instead of half an hour, and idle sessions no longer self-expire within a shift.
